outcome: Vaginal birth after cesarean delivery (VBAC) rate
cohort: Women giving birth at a community hospital between 2005 and 2014 (n=4884)
finding: The change from a private practice to a collaborative midwifery-laborist model was associated with a decrease in primary cesarean rates and an increase in VBAC rates.
mod_finding: This study found that the implementation of a collaborative midwifery-laborist model was associated with a decrease in primary cesarean delivery rates.
